C08-M02-L02-F1.title: Network vantage points and the telemetry each produces
C08-M02-L02-F1.caption: The devices on a workstation's traffic paths that write network logs, and how those logs reach the SIEM.
C08-M02-L02-F1.alt: Graph diagram. Workstation WS-104 (10.40.0.23, finance) sends a name lookup to the DNS resolver (query logs: client, name, type, rcode), HTTP(S) requests to the Web proxy / SWG (URL, user, status, bytes) and SMB on port 445 to the Internal file server (east-west destination). The DHCP server (lease logs: IP to host over time) assigns the workstation's address. The proxy sends egress to the Perimeter firewall (5-tuple, action, rule, NAT), which connects to the Internet (203.0.113.0/24 and other external hosts). A dashed SPAN / tap copy goes from the firewall to the NSM / IDS sensor (Zeek logs, Suricata alerts). A Flow exporter (switch / router: NetFlow, IPFIX) summarises the file-server traffic. The DNS resolver, DHCP server, proxy, firewall, sensor and flow exporter each send logs to the SIEM.

C08-M02-L02-F2.title: WS-104 proxy requests, 06:00-08:30 UTC (lab dataset)
C08-M02-L02-F2.caption: Every proxy request from the finance workstation in a 150-minute window, separated into beacon, routine and rare one-off destinations.
C08-M02-L02-F2.alt: Timeline from 06:00 to 08:30 UTC with three rows. Beacon to cdn-telemetry-sync.example: 18 evenly spaced ticks every 300 seconds, 220 bytes each, from 06:17 to 07:42. Routine sites: 8 irregular ticks (mail, intranet, maps, cdn) at 06:02, 06:04, 06:05, 06:40, 07:19, 07:44, 08:02 and 08:11. One-off rare destinations: 2 ticks, the invoice.docm download at 06:12 and the 48.2 MB upload at 08:12.
C08-M02-L02-F2.note: Machine-regular timing and size reveal the beacon without any payload; the rare singles are judged by type and volume.
